world: Scripted continuous piecewise-linear target trajectories, exogenous and identical across methods; five persistent entities, no ROS. Not paper-table replication or Ackermann.
observation: Pre-generated timestamped position packets every0.2s; CV finite-difference velocity; only received packet history accessible. Noise streams independent from planner RNG. Oracle future supplied only in separately labelled diagnostics.
risk_event: Per-future-time independent isotropic Gaussian disk event, not whole-mission probability. Actual scripted realization is deterministic conditional on scenario seed. Calibration against the finite scripted ensemble is descriptive, not a distribution-free guarantee.
budget: F3 one-factor snapshot sweeps with5 independent planner seeds. Closed loops are equal candidate budgets, not equal runtime. Deadline5/20/50ms snapshot rejection is separate from closed-loop outcomes.
claim: Mechanism diagnostics and independent strong baselines only; no new algorithm claim; all cases development, no held-out navigation claim.
